title: An anti-rug exit is refused while another exit of the same token holds the sell lock, and waits behind any routine private escalation that holds the wallet nonce lock, where its 60 s budget can run out

evidence.note: executeFullSell returns false at once when the per-token sell lock is held ("Another exit already handling token, skipping"), whatever the reason, anti-rug included
a detached partial sell holds the same lock for its whole submit (:1488-1591)
anti-rug clears the token timers, then runs executeFullSell under withTimeout(WATCHDOG_BUDGET_MS, default 60000 :77-81); a refusal or a timeout becomes success=false

submitPrivateSell holds the wallet nonce lock for the whole escalatePrivateSell, i.e. every private attempt and its confirm window (45 s default each, reconciliation.ts:55), so a routine exit of token A blocks every signing op of the wallet, including an anti-rug exit of token B
token B's anti-rug exit needs the nonce lock already for its approval; it can sit there past the 60 s budget
the budget frees only the caller; the queued exit still runs later with its stale balance read
22-28: with confirmBlocks 0 the gate awaits triggerAntiRugExit and discards the boolean; no pending-rug state is kept
22-28: with confirmBlocks > 0 the same; one gate fires once and removes its own block handler
22-28: the escape clears the poll timers first, then returns false on a refused or timed-out sell; the comment "retries on a later poll/anti-rug cycle" is not implemented

evidence.ref: node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --project realpath test/realpath/triage/AUD-EXIT-014.test.ts (Node 22.16.0, 2026-11-12; measure reworked in 20896a1) and in-memory mutants through scripts/vitest.in-memory-mutant.config.ts (Phase 23 code-review fixer C, WR-17)
evidence.note: the claim measures the outcome {antiRugExitSucceeded} (success true, or a sell submitted with reason anti-rug): false today. The routine exit's first private attempt misses and its second lands about 76 s after the rug, holding the sell lock and the nonce lock; antirug.cb-tripped appears in the same run. Mutants: queue-and-retry in triggerAntiRugExit reads looks fixed; a 3 s wait then a refusal records the bug; a plain wait for the sell lock inside executeFullSell and an anti-rug exit that skips the sell lock both end in antirug.exit.bounded-abort and record the bug

sibling_sites_checked: Lock holders that can block an anti-rug exit: a routine full exit of the same token (sell lock :832, held through the whole ladder), a detached partial of the same token (:1483), and any private escalation on the wallet (nonce lock :788, plus approvals :871/:874/:1509/:1512 and the public fallback :543/:552). Whether a refused anti-rug exit is retried depends on the anti-rug detector firing again on a new pool event (ANTIRUG slice; the dispatch at detector.ts:1341-1392 runs per event), and whether a refused or timed-out exit counts against the anti-rug circuit breaker is for the ANTIRUG slice too.
severity_rationale: S1 candidate. The refusals and the lock hold times are code facts. The plausible condition is a rug that starts while another exit is running: a price drop from early sell-offs triggers stop-loss first, and the liquidity pull arrives seconds later. The anti-rug exit is then dropped (same token) or delayed past its budget (another token). The in-flight routine exit keeps selling, but with routine parameters (two private attempts, 5% public slippage, no anti-rug gas multiplier), which is what makes it a loss case rather than a strand. Left candidate until the ANTIRUG slice confirms the retry and circuit-breaker behaviour. Confirmed at 22-28 against the code (see the last evidence entries and AUD-ANTIRUG-004 sub_claim 1): a refused or timed-out rug escape does not fire again; it recurs only on a new LP log or a backfill replay.
recommendation: Decide on card EXIT-11 how an anti-rug exit takes precedence over an in-flight exit (pre-empt it, escalate the in-flight one to anti-rug parameters, or queue and retry) and whether the nonce lock may be held across a whole private escalation. A fix must outlast or pre-empt an in-flight exit that holds the nonce lock: in the Phase 23 test the routine exit's first private attempt misses and its second lands about 76 s after the rug, holding the sell lock and the wallet nonce lock throughout, which is longer than the 60 s anti-rug watchdog; so a plain wait for the sell lock inside executeFullSell, or an anti-rug exit that skips only the sell lock, still ends in antirug.exit.bounded-abort (success false) for each dispatch (in-memory mutants), while queue-and-retry outside the watchdog reads fixed (a same-nonce replacement is the other shape that can). Today the immediate refusals from one pull already trip the anti-rug circuit breaker (antirug.cb-tripped in the same run): see AUD-ANTIRUG-003. (Both points added 2026-11-12 by operator ruling, process note PN-002.) Phase 24.

triage.note: Reproduced on the real path with the order forced (plan 23-08, AC-12; measure reworked in the Phase 23 code-review fix run, WR-17): ETH anti-rug live; a real stop-loss exit takes the sell lock, approves and is parked at its Flashbots simulation (eth_callBundle held on the relay, so the HTTP provider stays free, AUD-TX-028); a real 95 percent router liquidity pull is evaluated unsafe, the one-block confirm gate passes and the anti-rug exit is dispatched; it logs 'Another exit already handling token, skipping' (plain logs, reason anti-rug, no op) and its exit-fired broadcast carries success false at once, with the lock still held and no sell sent; released, the routine exit sells with reason stop-loss and the anti-rug exit never succeeds (claim antirug-exit-refused-while-sell-lock-held, measured as the outcome {antiRugExitSucceeded}: success true or a sell submitted with reason anti-rug). Queue-and-retry in triggerAntiRugExit reads looks fixed; a 3 s wait then a refusal does not; a plain wait for the sell lock inside executeFullSell and an anti-rug exit that skips only the sell lock do not either, because the in-flight routine exit holds the sell lock and the nonce lock about 76 s, past the 60 s watchdog (antirug.exit.bounded-abort). The nonce-lock delay behind another token's routine exit stays code-read (the buy case is AUD-TX-003).
